pages.text: $(bold)Myriad Spells as One$() (comes with Magic Gold, $(bold)leveled$())$(br2)$(bold)Only the single highest-level piece applies$() (it does not stack):$(li)max mana $(bold)+100 per level$()$(li)on hit: $(bold)level 5 Echoing Strikes$(), $(bold)free of mana$(), 45s cooldown$(li)at $(bold)20%$() health: $(bold)level 2 Abyssal Shroud$(), $(bold)free of mana$(), 300s cooldown$(br2)Note: both gifted spells use the scroll cast source - in Iron's Spells only spellbooks (and swords, if configured) consume mana, while scrolls consume none and ignore the mod's own cooldown, so these really are free.$(br2)$(italic)Every path of magic ends in the same place.$()
